correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=3, incidence BB^T=(n-2)I+J yields four nonzero adjacency projectors and a zero projector. Direct Schur-square expansion gives the orbit-block formula. Constant/standard/edge-kernel isotypic decomposition covers n+binom(n,2) dimensions, with standard block determinant (n-4)(n-3)/(2n(n-2)). Signs prove full rank iff n>=5, and direct boundary spectra prove ranks 3,7. Four symbolic identities, 2,882 exact matrix entries n=3..8 and 6 independent adjacency eigenspectra were replayed successfully from the bundled verifier. Finite checks are corroborative only; the proof is parameterized.
